subject: Spec: Scorecard progressive disclosure state machine (audit doc + 1 enhancement)
body:
## Current Implementation (verified)
Scorecard already implements 2-stage progressive disclosure:
- Stage 1: Score number, percentage, grade 1-4, coach message
- Stage 2: 'See Your Game Plan' button -> per-standard breakdown (standard / X/Y correct / icon)

This is the right pattern. No redesign needed.

## State Machine: Scorecard

States:
- COLLAPSED: Stage 1 visible only. Grade, percentage, coach message. 'See Your Game Plan' button shown.
- EXPANDED: Stage 1 + Stage 2 visible. Per-standard breakdown visible.
- PRINT: All visible, no interactive elements.

Transitions:
- COLLAPSED -> EXPANDED: User clicks 'See Your Game Plan'
- EXPANDED -> COLLAPSED: User clicks 'Hide Game Plan' (not currently implemented -- see Enhancement 1)
- Any state -> PRINT: window.print() called

## Enhancement 1: Toggle collapse/expand (medium)

Current 'See Your Game Plan' button appears and disappears after click -- can't un-expand.

Proposed: Button label toggles between 'See Your Game Plan' and 'Hide Game Plan'. aria-expanded toggles between 'false' and 'true'.

This is an ADHD-friendly pattern: Kai may want to review score summary after reading per-standard breakdown.

AC:
1. Button stays visible after expand
2. Label: 'See Your Game Plan' (COLLAPSED) / 'Hide Game Plan' (EXPANDED)
3. aria-expanded='false' (COLLAPSED) / 'true' (EXPANDED)
4. No animation needed -- toggle is instant

## Enhancement 2: Per-question detail view (low priority, future sprint)

Current scorecard shows per-standard aggregates only. Kai may want to see which specific questions he got wrong.

Not filing a spec for this now -- it requires design decisions about answer key exposure and feedback_wrong placement. Flagging for future sprint.

## Acceptance Criteria (Enhancement 1 only)
1. 'See Your Game Plan' button persists after expand
2. Becomes 'Hide Game Plan' after first click
3. Second click collapses and becomes 'See Your Game Plan' again
4. aria-expanded on button reflects state
5. No visual change to breakdown content itself

## What NOT to change
- Score number display
- Grade 1-4 logic
- Coach message copy
- Per-standard breakdown content
- Print behavior

## Scope
- exam.html scorecard toggle button only

## Priority: Medium

## Related
- sw-06: Scorecard progressive disclosure state machine (this spec)
